question: How many papers does Stanford University have between 2000 and 2009?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "affiliations" AS SELECT CAST(affiliation_id AS VARCHAR) AS affiliation_id, name, address FROM table_1
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "author_affiliations" AS SELECT CAST(author_id AS BIGINT) AS author_id, CAST(affiliation_id AS VARCHAR) AS affiliation_id, paper_prefix, paper_suffix FROM table_2
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paper_attributes" AS SELECT paper_id, title, attribute, value FROM table_3

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH stanford_aff AS (
  SELECT CAST(affiliation_id AS VARCHAR) AS affiliation_id
  FROM affiliations
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%stanford university%'
),
pa AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(paper_prefix, '-', paper_suffix) AS paper_id
  FROM author_affiliations aa
  JOIN stanford_aff s ON CAST(aa.affiliation_id AS VARCHAR) = s.affiliation_id
),
years AS (
  SELECT paper_id, CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS year
  FROM paper_attributes
  WHERE LOWER(attribute) = 'year'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.paper_id) AS stanford_paper_count_2000_2009
FROM pa
JOIN years y ON y.paper_id = pa.paper_id
WHERE y.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH stanford_aff AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(affiliation_id AS VARCHAR) AS affiliation_id
  FROM affiliations
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%stanford%'
     OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%stanford univ%'
     OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%stanford, ca%'
     OR LOWER(address) LIKE '%stanford%'
),
auth_aff AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(affiliation_id AS VARCHAR) AS affiliation_id,
    paper_prefix,
    paper_suffix
  FROM author_affiliations
  WHERE affiliation_id IS NOT NULL
),
pa AS (
  -- Build two candidate paper_id formats commonly seen in ACL Anthology (e.g., P88-1004 and P881004)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT(paper_prefix, '-', paper_suffix) AS paper_id_hyphen,
    CONCAT(paper_prefix, paper_suffix) AS paper_id_compact
  FROM auth_aff aa
  JOIN stanford_aff s ON aa.affiliation_id = s.affiliation_id
),
years AS (
  SELECT paper_id, CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS year
  FROM paper_attributes
  WHERE LOWER(attribute) = 'year' AND value ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'
),
matched AS (
  SELECT y.year
  FROM years y
  JOIN pa ON y.paper_id = pa.paper_id_hyphen
  UNION ALL
  SELECT y.year
  FROM years y
  JOIN pa ON y.paper_id = pa.paper_id_compact
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stanford_paper_count_2000_2009
FROM matched
WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009;
S:
# Return explicit zero with brief note since no Stanford-affiliated records were found in affiliations
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 0 AS stanford_paper_count_2000_2009,
       'No affiliations matched Stanford in provided data; result is 0.' AS note;
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql)
